Hey Ekaterina,

I noticed your Block Scholes London office is about 2 min walk from our Holborn clinic.

Reason I'm writing: if Block Scholes gives you private health cover, physio is almost certainly included in it. Most people barely touch it. I run One Body LDN. 38 physio locations across London, 7,764 reviews at 4.9, and we see a lot of people from big companies like KPMG, Deloitte and PwC.

So if something's nagging like lower back from sitting, neck, shoulder, a knee that complains when you run, we'll do your provider side from start to finish. Booking and paperwork. Most people are surprised to find nothing comes out of pocket.

messages.subject: you walk past us every day
messages.text:
Hi Gabriel,

I noticed your Primer London office is about 3 min walk from our Liverpool Street clinic.

Reason I'm writing: if Primer gives you private health cover, physio is almost certainly included in it. Most people barely touch it. I run One Body LDN. 38 physio locations across London, 7,764 reviews at 4.9, and we see a lot of people from big companies like KPMG, Deloitte and PwC.

So if something's nagging like lower back from sitting, neck, shoulder, a knee that complains when you run, we'll do your provider side from start to finish. Booking and paperwork. Most people are surprised to find nothing comes out of pocket.

And if you haven't got cover, your first 55-minute session with hands-on treatment is on us anyway. Want me to send you the booking code? Just reply and it's yours.

Best regards
Kurt Johnson
Co-Founder @ One Body LDN

messages.subject: the benefit nobody uses
messages.text:
Hey Tiffany,

I noticed your Strutt & Parker London office is about 4 min walk from our Marylebone clinic.

Reason I'm writing: if Strutt & Parker gives you private health cover, physio is almost certainly included in it. Most people barely touch it. I run One Body LDN. 38 physio locations across London, 7,764 reviews at 4.9, and we see a lot of people from big companies like KPMG, Deloitte and PwC.

So if something's nagging like lower back from sitting, neck, shoulder, a knee that complains when you run, we'll do your provider side from start to finish. Booking and paperwork. Most people are surprised to find nothing comes out of pocket.

And if you haven't got cover, your first 55-minute session with hands-on treatment is on us anyway. Want me to send you the booking code? Just reply and it's yours.

Kind regards
Rebecca Bossick

Hello Howard,

So if something's nagging like lower back from sitting, neck, shoulder, a knee that complains when you run, we'll do your provider side from start to finish. Booking and paperwork. Most people are surprised to find nothing comes out of pocket.
